summary: Federal Communications Commission urged to preserve E-Rate program to ensure schools can maintain essential infrastructure and allocate resources to other educational priorities.

claims.argument: Without E-Rate support, districts would have to allocate more local funds to maintain essential infrastructure, potentially diverting resources from other educational priorities
claims.evidence_quote: Without that support, those costs would have to come directly from our local budget—meaning fewer dollars available for classroom technology, instructional programs, staffing, and other student needs.
